ruleContent.content:
<js>var out = "";

function safeString(v) {
    return String(v || "");
}

function decryptJJ(content) {
    return String(java.createSymmetricCrypto("DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding", "KW8Dvm2N", "1ae2c94b").decryptStr(content));
}

// VIP已购章节：响应为纯密文，密钥由响应头 accesskey/keystring 动态派生
// 解密后得到JSON，其content字段再用固定密钥二次解密
function decryptVipRaw(rawBody, ak, ks) {
    ak = String(ak || "");
    ks = String(ks || "");
    if (!ak || !ks || !rawBody) { return ""; }
    var v6 = ak.charCodeAt(ak.length - 1);
    var v9 = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < ak.length; i++) { v9 += ak.charCodeAt(i); }
    var v15 = v9 % ks.length;
    var v17 = Math.floor(v9 / 65);
    var v43 = ks.substring(v15, (v17 + v15 > ks.length) ? ks.length : (v17 + v15));
    var v38, dest;
    if ((v6 & 1) !== 0) {
        v38 = rawBody.slice(-12);
        dest = rawBody.slice(0, -12);
    } else {
        v38 = rawBody.slice(0, 12);
        dest = rawBody.slice(12);
    }
    var key = String(java.md5Encode(v43 + v38)).slice(0, 8);
    var iv = String(java.md5Encode(v38)).slice(0, 8);
    return String(java.createSymmetricCrypto("DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding", key, iv).decryptStr(dest));
}

// 响应是否为VIP密文体（非JSON、无content字段、长度足够）
function isRawCipher(b) {
    return b && b.length > 60 && !/^\s*\{/.test(b) && b.indexOf('"content"') < 0 && b.indexOf('"message"') < 0 && b.indexOf('"code"') < 0;
}

try {
    var url = safeString(baseUrl);
    var body = "";

    if (/^data:/i.test(url)) {
        // 旧缓存 data: 链接兼容
        var params = bDe(url);
        var real = "https://app.jjwxc.org/androidapi/chapterContent?versionCode=381&" + params;
        var resp0 = java.get(real, {});
        body = safeString(resp0.body());
        if (isRawCipher(body)) {
            body = decryptVipRaw(body, resp0.header("accesskey"), resp0.header("keystring"));
        }
    } else {
        body = safeString(result);
        if (isRawCipher(body)) {
            // VIP已购章节：正文是密文，需要响应头，用 java.get 重新请求
            var resp = java.get(url, {});
            var raw = safeString(resp.body());
            if (isRawCipher(raw)) {
                body = decryptVipRaw(raw, resp.header("accesskey"), resp.header("keystring"));
            } else {
                body = raw;
            }
        }
    }

    var json = null;
    try { json = JSON.parse(body); } catch (e) { json = null; }

    if (json) {
        var content = safeString(json.content);
        var message = safeString(json.message);
        var say = safeString(json.sayBodyV2 || json.sayBody).replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").trim();
        var sayPart = say ? "\n\n———— 作者有话说 ————\n" + say : "";

        if (content.length > 30) {
            try {
                var dec = decryptJJ(content);
                if (/[一-龥]/.test(dec)) {
                    out = dec.trim() + sayPart;
                } else {
                    out = "❀正文解密结果不是中文文本，晋江接口加密方式可能已变更，请反馈书源维护者。";
                }
            } catch (e) {
                out = "❀正文解密失败：" + e + "\n可能登录已失效，请重新登录后再试。";
            }
        } else if (message) {
            var token = safeString(Map("token"));
            var hasToken = /^\d+_[\w\d]{16,}/.test(token);
            var isVipMsg = /VIP|登入|登录|购买|付费|余额|晋江币|精彩/.test(message);
            var buyGuide = "\n\n📖 购买本章（消耗晋江币）：\n① 点击屏幕中间，唤出阅读菜单\n② 点击顶部书源名「晋江」按钮\n③ 点击「购买」并确认\n购买成功后本章会自动刷新显示。";
            if (isVipMsg && hasToken) {
                out = "🔒 " + message + "\n\n当前已登录（token " + token.slice(0, token.indexOf("_") + 5) + "...），本章尚未购买。" + buyGuide;
            } else if (isVipMsg && !hasToken) {
                out = "🔒 " + message + "\n\n当前未检测到有效登录 token。\n请先登录：书源管理 → 晋江 → 登录（账密登录 / 扫码登录），然后再打开本章购买。";

            }
        } else if (content) {
            out = "🔒 本章可能为 VIP 章节且暂不可读，请先登录并购买后再试。";
        } else {
            out = "❀章节响应中没有正文内容：\n" + body.slice(0, 200);
        }
    } else if (body.length > 100) {
        try {
            var dec2 = decryptJJ(body);
            out = /[一-龥]/.test(dec2) ? dec2 : ("❀响应无法识别：\n" + body.slice(0, 150));
        } catch (e) {

} catch (e) {

ruleExplore.bookList:
<js>
var html = String(src);
var pageBooks = [];
var seen = {};
var re = /href="\/book2\/(\d+)"[^>]*>([^<]{1,80})<\/a>(\s*-\s*<a href="\/wapauthor\/\d+"[^>]*>([^<]{1,40})<\/a>)?/g;
var m;
while ((m = re.exec(html)) !== null) {
    if (seen[m[1]]) { continue; }
    seen[m[1]] = true;
    pageBooks.push({
        id: m[1],
        name: String(m[2]).replace(/[《》]/g, "").trim(),
        author: m[4] ? String(m[4]).trim() : ""
    });
}

var MAX = 60;
var books = [];
var urls = [];
for (var i = 0; i < pageBooks.length && i < MAX; i++) {
    urls.push("https://app-cdn.jjwxc.net/androidapi/novelbasicinfo?novelId=" + pageBooks[i].id);
}

function mkBook(name, author, id, cover, intro, kind, size) {
    return {
        name: name,
        author: author,
        bookUrl: "https://app-cdn.jjwxc.net/androidapi/novelbasicinfo?novelId=" + id,
        coverUrl: cover,
        intro: intro,
        kind: kind,
        wordCount: size
    };
}

if (urls.length > 0) {
    try {
        var resps = java.ajaxAll(urls);
        for (var j = 0; j < resps.length; j++) {
            try {
                var d = JSON.parse(String(resps[j].body()));
                if (!d || !d.novelName) { continue; }
                var intro = String(d.novelIntro || d.novelIntroShort || "");
                intro = intro.replace(/<br\/?>/gi, " ")
                    .replace(/<[^&]*>/g, " ")
                    .replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, " ")
                    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ")
                    .replace(/ /g, " ")
                    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
                    .trim();
                if (intro.length > 100) { intro = intro.slice(0, 100) + "…"; }
                var tags = String(d.novelTags || "").split(",");
                var kindArr = [];
                for (var t = 0; t < tags.length && kindArr.length < 3; t++) {
                    if (tags[t]) { kindArr.push(tags[t]); }
                }
                kindArr.push(String(d.novelStep) == "2" ? "已完结" : "连载中");
                books.push(mkBook(
                    String(d.novelName),
                    String(d.authorName || ""),
                    String(d.novelId || ""),
                    String(d.novelCover || ""),
                    intro,
                    kindArr.join(","),
                    String(d.novelsizeformat || "")
                ));
            } catch (e) { }
        }
    } catch (eAll) {
        java.log("explore ajaxAll error: " + eAll);
    }
}

if (books.length === 0) {
    for (var k = 0; k < pageBooks.length && k < MAX; k++) {
        books.push(mkBook(pageBooks[k].name, pageBooks[k].author, pageBooks[k].id, "", "", "", ""));
    }
}

result = JSON.stringify(books);
</js>

	}
